prompt: Change our GitHub Actions deploy (.github/workflows/deploy.yml) so that every production deploy uses the day of the deploy itself (today's date, UTC) as the Worker's compatibility date, instead of the date written in wrangler.jsonc. Leave wrangler.jsonc as it is; its date stays the default for local development.

correct..github/workflows/deploy.yml:
name: Deploy

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - run: npm ci
      - name: Deploy the Worker
        run: npx wrangler deploy --compatibility-date "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)"
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}

name: Deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: echo "TODAY=$(date -u +%F)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - run: npx wrangler deploy --compatibility-date=${{ env.TODAY }}
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}

name: Deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run deploy:prod
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}

wrong..github/workflows/deploy.yml:
name: Deploy

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - run: npm ci
      - name: Deploy the Worker
        run: npx wrangler deploy --latest
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}

name: Deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run deploy:prod
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}

trap: wrangler deploy --latest now sets the compatibility date to the bundled workerd's release date (2026-10-06 in 4.148.0), not today's date, so a deploy job built on --latest does not use the day of the deploy.
